story:
Before Miguel Cornejo opened MNM Roofing, he spent years working as a subcontractor for several large and reputable roofing companies across the region — learning the best technique from each of them, and getting a close look at the shortcuts he would never take himself. He founded MNM Roofing in Nanticoke, Pennsylvania in 2018, and the company grew quickly on word of mouth.

Today MNM operates out of its main hub in Greentown, PA, serving the Poconos and the surrounding communities, with a second office back in Nanticoke covering Luzerne County and a growing presence in Whitehall Township for the Lehigh Valley. Miguel's wife Megan runs the office. Every installer on the crew is a qualified craftsman, personally trained by Miguel and working alongside him on the job — MNM has never handed a roof to a subcontractor and does not intend to.

That one decision is what everything else rests on. Because the crew is ours, we can put a 10-year workmanship warranty in writing on every full replacement and add our own 15-year craftsman warranty on top of it. It is also why the details get done: tear-off cleared as we go rather than piled on your lawn, a magnet sweep of the driveway and yard before the trucks leave, and a final walk-through with you before we call the job finished. We are licensed in Pennsylvania under PA154140, bonded, insured, and BBB accredited with an A+ rating — and we would rather be known for doing it right than for doing it fast.
